title: RBI bank-dividend-payout cap saga
summary: **[Jan]** RBI raises bank dividend payout cap to **75% of net profit** (from 40%), CET1-linked, 10-bucket structure by capital buffer.

items: **[Jan]** RBI raises bank dividend payout cap to **75% of net profit** (from 40%), CET1-linked, 10-bucket structure by capital buffer.
**[Mar] 🔄 Full mechanism confirmed:** payout capped at 75% of **Profit After Tax (PAT)**
banks with CET1 just above regulatory minimum get **no dividend**
stronger banks may pay up to **100% of Adjusted PAT** (subject to the overall 75%-of-PAT cap)
Adjusted PAT = PAT − 50% of net NPAs (as of 31 March). **Effective FY27.**

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → 🔥 HIGH — 75% dividend cap is RBI's marquee reform of the quarter; the CET1-linkage + Adjusted-PAT formula is the testable mechanism.
